title: Rummy Guru: Which App Is It? Same-Name Apps Checked
excerpt: Several unrelated apps and websites use the name Rummy Guru. What we found on Google Play and the web, and how to check any Rummy Guru APK before installing.
content:
**Short answer:** there is no single "Rummy Guru". The name is used by several unrelated apps and websites. On 28 September 2026, the only app called Rummy Guru listed on Google Play in India was published by **Ridhi siddhi enterprise**. Other "Rummy Guru" apps have left Google Play, and several websites calling themselves "official" serve APK files named after other brands.

This article records what we checked and when. It is not a recommendation to install or play any app. Several of these sites advertise cash bonuses; online money games are prohibited in India under the Online Gaming Act, 2025 (see our [online gaming laws guide](/blog/online-gaming-laws-in-india-what-players-should-know)). 18+ only.

## What We Found (Checked 28 September 2026)

| Where | Name shown | Package or file | What we observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Google Play (India) | Rummy Guru | com.skridhis.rummyguru | Listed. Developer: Ridhi siddhi enterprise. Updated 25 September 2026. 100+ downloads. Rated 18+. Developer contact is a Gmail address. |
| Google Play | Rummy Guru | com.skcasino.rummyguru | Not listed (Play returns "Not found"). |
| Google Play | "Rummy Garu" | com.rummyguru | Not listed. |
| APK sites | Rummy Guru Online-Indian Card Game | jpk.sdfg.webxc | Not listed on Google Play. |
| rummyguru.org | "Rummy Guru Official" | TeenPattiGold-31.apk | The download button serves a file named after a different brand. Advertises a ₹1,500 sign-up bonus. |
| rummy-guru.in | "India's best Rummy App" | Master_4r04x4.apk | File name does not mention Rummy Guru. |

We checked Google Play package pages directly and downloaded no APK files. Other copies may exist; a name match alone tells you very little.

## What the Google Play "Rummy Guru" Contains

The listed app by Ridhi siddhi enterprise describes itself as a collection of card and casual games with in-app coins, including Rummy Gold, Teen Patti, Andar Bahar, Dragon Tiger, Callbreak, 7 Up 7 Down, Ludo, Lucky Plinko and Lucky Slots, plus a Wallet, Daily Bonus, Lucky Spin and Scratch Card features. It is not a rummy-only app, despite its name.

## A Note on This Site's Own Listing

AllYonoGuru's [Rummy Guru](/rummy-guru) listing currently links to a Yono-network download domain, not to any of the apps in the table above. The version number shown on that listing has not been independently verified. We are reviewing it under our [editorial policy](/editorial-policy).

## Why So Many Apps Share the Name

"Rummy" and "Guru" are generic words, and nobody owns the combination. Some publishers reuse a popular name to attract searches. Some websites use it as a landing page for whichever APK they are promoting that month. That is why a version number or a "Download" button on a page called Rummy Guru does not tell you which app you will actually get.

## How to Check Any Rummy Guru App

- **Compare the package name.** On Android, Settings → Apps → the app → App details shows it. Match it against the table above.
- **Check the developer.** A Play listing names its developer; a website usually does not.
- **Look at the file name** before installing. A file named after a different brand is a warning sign.
- **Read the permissions** the app requests. See [Android app permissions before you install](/blog/understanding-android-app-permissions-before-you-install).
- **Never pay an "unlock" or "withdrawal" fee**, and never share an OTP or UPI PIN.

If you have lost money to a fake app, call the National Cyber Crime Helpline on **1930** or report it at cybercrime.gov.in. Our [Responsible Gaming](/responsible-gaming) page lists more help.

## Learn the Game Instead

If you want to learn rummy itself, start with [how to play 13-card rummy](/blog/how-to-play-13-card-rummy-rules) and [rummy sequence rules](/blog/rummy-sequence-rules-pure-sequence-explained). Those rules are the same whichever app you use.
